definitions.gloss: to enjoy; to have fun; to take pleasure in
definitions.explanation: To find pleasure or satisfaction in an activity or experience.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}を{楽|たの}しむ。
{人生|じんせい}を{楽|たの}しんでいる。
{食事|しょくじ}を{楽|たの}しみながら{話|はなし}をする。
examples.english: To talk while enjoying a meal.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
- {楽|たの}しむ (dictionary form)
- {楽|たの}しみます (polite)
- {楽|たの}しんで (te-form)
- {楽|たの}しんだ (past)
- {楽|たの}しめる (potential)

PATTERNS:
- ～を{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy ~
- ～を{楽|たの}しみにする: to look forward to ~

RELATED:
- {楽|たの}しい: fun, enjoyable (adjective)
- {楽|たの}しみ: enjoyment, pleasure (noun)
